quote1: Only a confirmed order becomes a purchase.
faq1q: Does every order go to Meta?
faq1a: No. Confirma sends a Purchase only after you confirm the order. Unconfirmed and fake COD orders stay out of Meta, TikTok, and Google.
faq2a: WooCommerce and YouCan connect from the store step. Shopify uses the same connect form when the store install is available.
faq3a: Open Meta Events Manager, then Overview. A confirmed order appears as a Purchase. Test Events stays empty unless you add a test event code.
faq4a: Billing is off. You can connect a store and send confirmed orders without entering a card.
faq5q: Does it work with WooCommerce and YouCan?
faq5a: Yes. Connect either store, confirm the order, and Confirma sends that purchase to Meta, TikTok, and Google.
faq6q: Do I need Meta App Review?
faq6a: You connect your own pixel and token. Confirma does not submit an app for Meta review on your behalf. Your Meta account still follows Meta's access rules for that pixel.
exampleNote: Facebook learns from 40 real orders only, not from 100.
